candidates.statement: Order service postgres connection pool is exhausted (size 5, idle 0), so save_order waits ~2s and fails with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout and checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle come from trace attributes only; no postgres-side pool metrics or logs admitted to confirm saturation versus slow queries.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s preceded by order ReadTimeout, order 503s, and postgres.save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable at ~2s while pool size=5 and idle=0 across all sampled requests. Order metrics show 13.7 503s/min on /v1/orders and postgres save_order failures. Consistent with db-pool-exhaustion; deployment record only establishes order v1.0.0 and does not establish causation.
missing_evidence: Postgres connection pool metrics (wait time, active/idle, acquisition timeouts) for order service
Order service logs showing pool acquisition timeout or exhaustion errors
Postgres server-side latency/query duration for save_order
